adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `addGuestsHandler` builds a `CalendarEvent` with `recurringEvent: parseRecurringEvent(booking.eventType?.recurringEvent)` and then updates attendees on a single `booking` record (`prisma.booking.update({ where: { id: bookingId }, ... attendees.createMany ... })`). However, the claim that this booking represents only a single occurrence (with other occurrences stored separately and needing separate attendee insertion) is not established anywhere in the diff. In Cal.com’s model a single booking can represent a recurring series (with `startTime/endTime` as the first instance and `eventType.recurringEvent` defining the RRULE), in which case including `recurringEvent` in the ICS/email is correct. The diff alone doesn’t demonstrate the mismatch the finding asserts.
